edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller unconditional ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], the caller-chosen source account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] from the caller-controlled address.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership with require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrant callbacks.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an unverified tokenAddress contract.
safeAdd evaluates a + b before the overflow guard, an arithmetic operation site.
safeSub evaluates a - b after the underflow guard, an arithmetic operation site.
safeMul evaluates a * b before the overflow guard, an arithmetic operation site.
transfer delegates balance subtraction to safeSub.
transfer delegates balance addition to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates both balance and allowance subtraction to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates recipient credit to safeAdd.
